不制造干扰：重复呼叫、在错误频率发射只会拖慢全场。: Do not cause interference: calling repeatedly or transmitting on the wrong frequency only slows everyone down.
严格遵守 split 规则，只在其指定收听频率呼叫。: Follow the split rule strictly: call only on the listening frequency they announce.
基金会赞助、个人募捐，以及 OQRS 通联确认费用。: Foundation sponsorship, private donations, and OQRS confirmation fees.
多名操作员、多台设备、多个波段/模式同时工作，昼夜轮班。: Several operators and radios working several bands and modes at once, in shifts around the clock.
按每年活跃台数量划分 Most Wanted，越稀有追台越热烈。: The Most Wanted list ranks entities by the number of stations active each year; the rarer it is, the hotter the chase.
提前在 DX Cluster 与公告板了解远征时间与频率计划。: Check the DX cluster and bulletin boards in advance for the expedition's timing and frequency plan.
组织团队前往稀有或无人 DXCC 实体临时设台，满足全球通联需求。: A team travels to a rare or uninhabited DXCC entity and sets up temporarily to satisfy worldwide demand for contacts.
远征台常按分区、前缀或大洲点名，耐心等待轮到你。: Expeditions often call by zone, prefix or continent — wait patiently for your turn.
远征期间或结束上传 Club Log 与 LoTW，供全球核对确认。: Uploads to Club Log and LoTW during or after the expedition, so everyone can check confirmations.
通过 OQRS 直接请求 QSL 卡，或等待 LoTW 上传确认。: Request a QSL card directly via OQRS, or wait for the LoTW upload to confirm.
